Based on the provided authoritative legal context, here is the analysis regarding claiming a deduction for rent:

**1. House Rent Allowance (HRA) Exemption under Section 10(13A)**
If you are a salaried employee receiving House Rent Allowance (HRA) as part of your salary, you may claim an exemption under **Section 10(13A)** [C5].
*   **Regime Restriction:** This exemption is available **only if the Old Tax Regime is opted** [C5].
*   **Calculation Limit:** The exempt allowance for HRA cannot exceed the minimum of:
    *   50% of Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance (DA) as per Section 17(1); or
    *   The actual HRA received as per Section 17(1) [C5].
*   **Documentation:** If the aggregate rent paid during the previous year exceeds Rs. 1,00,000, you must furnish the name, address, and Permanent Account Number (PAN) of the landlord/landlords to your employer for TDS purposes under **Section 192** [C7].

**2. Deduction for Rent Paid under Section 80GG**
If you do not receive HRA or wish to claim a specific deduction for rent paid for self-occupied accommodation, you may be eligible for a deduction under **Section 80GG** [C1].
*   **Regime Restriction:** This deduction **cannot be claimed if the New Tax Regime is selected** [C1].
*   **Interaction with HRA:** If HRA under Section 10(13A) is claimed, a deduction under Section 80GG above Rs. 55,000 is not allowed [C1].
*   **Condition Precedent:** The deduction under Section 80GG is subject to the condition that the assessee files a declaration in **Form No. 10BA** as per the Income-tax Rules, 1962 [C3].

**3. Restrictions under New Tax Regime**
If you have opted for the **New Tax Regime**:
*   You **cannot** claim the deduction under Section 80GG [C1].
*   You **cannot** claim the exemption for HRA under Section 10(13A) (as it is restricted to the Old Regime) [C5].

**Summary of Eligibility:**
*   **Old Regime:** You can claim HRA exemption under Section 10(13A) [C5] and/or Section 80GG deduction (subject to limits and Form 10BA) [C1, C3].
*   **New Regime:** You cannot claim rent-related deductions/exemptions under Section 80GG or Section 10(13A) [C1, C5].

For precise statutory limits not explicitly detailed in these chunks, please refer to the full text of the Income Tax Act, 1961.*
